title: CertBIM – BIM Process Standardization
excerpt: CertBIM thus aims to support the structuring of content oriented towards the standardization of BIM-related processes.
content:
CertBIM thus aims to support the structuring of content oriented towards the standardization of BIM-related processes.

The international standardization landscape seeks to regulate the implementation of BIM through a cross-cutting focus on the different segments of the AEC sector. The flow of development of European standards related to BIM, directly or indirectly, requires the close monitoring of normative documentation that focuses on both good practices and fundamental rules of mandatory application.

CertBIM thus aims to support the structuring of content, specific to each segment, oriented towards the standardization of processes related to BIM methodology. The compliance of the practice with the regulations will benefit the sector as a whole through a properly structured communication.

Main Activities

  • Monitoring of international standardization
